name: Portugal

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - adult
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Common Schengen fee. Children 6-12 pay EUR 45; under 6 free. Payable in EUR or local currency at ECB rates. VFS USA lists USD 104 effective Apr 2026. Fee waived for students/teachers on study trips, researchers, non-profit reps under 25, and family members of EU/EEA/CH/UK nationals.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - business purpose
fees.validity: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Same Type C visa and fee as tourism; purpose is stated at application.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Standard Schengen visa fee applies to airport transit visas.

fees.name: e-Visa
fees.notes: Portugal does not operate a tourist e-visa; applications are lodged at consulates/VFS. (EU ETIAS, EUR 20, is planned for visa-exempt travellers but not yet in force as of 2026-07-02.)

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Portugal does not issue visas on arrival except rare border visas in exceptional circumstances under the Schengen Visa Code.

reciprocity_variations.note: EU visa facilitation agreement rate (Belarus partial). Per Portuguese MFA visa-fees page.
Cabo Verde facilitation agreement: adults EUR 67.75, children 12-18 EUR 33.75, under 12 free.
EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement suspended since 2022; standard EUR 90 fee applies.

vfs.service_fee: USD 43.91 (USA centres); MFA caps external-provider service fee at EUR 45, up to EUR 80-120 where Portugal has no consulate
vfs.note: Service fee varies by centre/country. Verified published figure: US $43.91 incl. VAT per application (VFS Portugal-USA one-pager). India and other centres publish fees dynamically on booking portals.

free_visa_notes: Visa-free for EU/EEA/Schengen nationals and ~60 visa-exempt nationalities (USA, GBR, CAN, JPN, etc.) for stays up to 90/180 days. Visa fee waived for children under 6, students/teachers on study trips, researchers, and family members of EU/EEA/CH/UK citizens.
